name: Cashfree
tagline: Payments, settlements, and reports your agent can query.
description: Cashfree Payments is a payments platform for Indian businesses. Agents can search transactions and orders, check settlements, generate reconciliation reports, create payment links and orders, and issue refunds through the official hosted MCP server.

methods.label: OAuth 2.0 (merchant dashboard login)
methods.note: Log in with a Cashfree merchant account that has owner-level access. Clients register themselves through dynamic client registration.

auth.guide:
**Hosted MCP (only path):** the official server at `https://mcp.cashfree.com/mcp` uses OAuth. Compatible clients discover the authorization server from `https://mcp.cashfree.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`, register through dynamic client registration, and open the Cashfree Merchant Dashboard login in the browser. Use a merchant account with owner-level access.

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http cashfree https://mcp.cashfree.com/mcp
```

Then run `/mcp`, select **cashfree**, and choose **Login**. The server advertises the scopes `mcp-workflows-read`, `mcp-workflows-write`, `mcp-pg-read`, and `mcp-pg-write`. The token endpoint accepts `client_secret_post` and PKCE uses `S256`. Disconnecting a client revokes the refresh token for that grant.
